topic: Day 125 — reel — Forgiving yourself is harder because you're both judge and defendant
text:
Forgiving
yourself is slow.
You're both [judge]
and defendant.
caption:
Self-forgiveness asks you to hold two roles in the same process. That's why it usually takes longer than forgiving anyone else.

Follow for one of these a day.
